about_the_game:
Step into an animal kingdom where wits and strategy collide. The king’s financial advisor is about to retire, and the great animal houses are mobilizing — through auctions and investments, they’ll battle for the throne of wealth. Only one can rise to power and become the kingdom’s next financial mastermind!

This is a strategy game that combines resource management and auction mechanics. You’ll take on the role of uniquely styled animal characters, collecting valuable items from the forest and bidding for them at the grand royal auction. With clever combinations, sharp judgment, and flexible financial tactics, you must outwit your opponents in high-stakes auctions to earn the most wealth and claim your place as the kingdom’s financial advisor.

Key Features:

🦊 Strategic Auction Gameplay – Time your bids, read your rivals, and craft your auction strategy to gain the upper hand in turn-based bidding battles.

👑 Single & Multiplayer Modes – Whether facing off against cunning AI or challenging your friends, the game delivers tense, strategic showdowns every round.

Enter this vibrant yet power-hungry animal world and prove your financial savvy to claim the glory that’s rightfully yours!
